name: gh-security
description: Resolve Dependabot alerts in parallel across a repo, org, or your own repos: one subagent per package major line per repo in an isolated worktree, ranked by severity and EPSS, with lockfile validation, major-bounded scoped overrides, draft PRs carrying a computed merge-risk rating, a check-aware mark-ready flow, and a pin audit that finds overrides no longer needed and opens a draft PR removing them.
